title: He Will Not Forsake His Saints

questions.question: Fret not yourself because of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 37:1 (ESV): "Fret not yourself because of evildoers; be not envious of wrongdoers!"

questions.question: For they will soon fade like the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 37:2 (ESV): "For they will soon fade like the grass and wither like the green herb."

questions.question: Trust in the Lord, and do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 37:3 (ESV): "Trust in the Lord, and do good; dwell in the land and befriend faithfulness."

questions.question: Delight yourself in the Lord, and he will give you the desires of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 37:4 (ESV): "Delight yourself in the Lord, and he will give you the desires of your heart."

questions.question: Commit your way to the Lord; trust in him, and he will do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 37:5 (ESV): "Commit your way to the Lord; trust in him, and he will act."

questions.question: Be still before the Lord and wait patiently for him; fret not yourself over the one who prospers in his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 37:7 (ESV): "...fret not yourself over the one who prospers in his way,"

questions.question: Refrain from anger, and forsake wrath! Fret not yourself; it tends only to what?
But the meek shall inherit the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 37:11 (ESV): "But the meek shall inherit the land and delight themselves in abundant peace."

questions.question: The wicked borrows but does not pay back, but the righteous is generous and does what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 37:21 (ESV): "The wicked borrows but does not pay back, but the righteous is generous and gives;"

questions.question: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken or his children begging for what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 37:25 (ESV): "...yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken or his children begging for bread."

questions.question: The salvation of the righteous is from whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 37:39 (ESV): "The salvation of the righteous is from the Lord; he is their stronghold in the time of trouble."

questions.question: Mark the blameless and behold the upright, for there is a future for the man of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 37:37 (ESV): "...for there is a future for the man of peace."

questions.question: I have seen a wicked, ruthless man, spreading himself like a green Laurel tree, but he passed away, and behold, he was what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 37:35-36 (ESV): "...but he passed away, and behold, he was no more;"

questions.question: The mouth of the righteous utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 37:30 (ESV): "The mouth of the righteous utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice."

questions.question: Psalm 37 is an acrostic poem. True or False?
questions.explanation: Like Psalm 25, Psalm 37 is an alphabetic acrostic psalm.

key_verse_text: Delight yourself in the Lord, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
